name: Banana Oat Smoothie
steps: Remove all date pits and chop the dates. If firm, soak them in a little of the measured milk until softened so they blend without leaving hard pieces.
Peel the bananas and break them into chunks. Put banana, oats, dates with their soaking milk, the remaining milk and cinnamon in the blender.
Blend until smooth, then pause and scrape the sides. Blend again if you can still see date pieces or coarse oat flakes.
Check the texture and add a small splash of milk if you prefer a thinner drink. The oats will continue to thicken the smoothie as it stands.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately for the best colour and texture. Stir again before drinking if it has been left to stand briefly.
tips: Use oat milk for a dairy-free version and check its ingredient label.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
passiveTime: See soaking/resting time in the steps
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
